run_calculate_primes: run the multiprocessing gRPC client to check primality of integers up to 10000
run_worker_query: run a single primality check RPC against the gRPC PrimeChecker server
initialize_worker: initialize a gRPC insecure channel and PrimeCheckerStub for a worker process
shutdown_worker: shutdown the worker process gRPC channel and clean up resources
review_main: review the argparse CLI entry point that parses server address and runs prime calculation
